The resolvable half of the reference-unresolved fixture.

The case directory stands in for the repository root, so the ticket's
`docs/present.txt` reference resolves to this file and produces no finding. Its
`docs/missing.md` reference has nothing to resolve to, and that is the one the
expectation records.

This file is deliberately not Markdown. Every .md file under testdata/ is a
ticket fixture, and a stray one here would be checked as a ticket that has no
frontmatter.
